newsitem.title: USA: Deana Carter, George Strait lead award nominations.
newsitem.headline: Deana Carter, George Strait lead award nominations.

text.p: Comparative newcomer Deana Carter tied with veteran George Strait to lead the pack of nominees announced on Tuesday for this year's Country Music Association awards.
Carter and Strait were each nominated in five categories -- including the prized "Entertainer of the Year" slot for Strait.
Faith Hill, Alan Jackson, Tim McGraw, LeAnn Rimes and Pam Tillis each received three nominations for the awards which will be presented on September 24 at the Grand Ole Opry.

Nominated for "Entertainer of the Year" along with Strait were Brooks and Dunn -- last year's winners -- Jackson, Vince Gill and Garth Books, who is slated to perform a mega concert in New York's Central Park this Thursday.
"Male Vocalist of the Year" -- Gill, Jackson, Strait, Collin Raye and Bryan White; "Female Vocalist of the Year" -- Carter, Rimes, Tillis, Patty Loveless and Trisha Yearwood.
"Horizon Award" -- Trace Adkins, Carter, Terri Clark, Rimes and Lee Ann Womack; "Vocal Group of the Year" -- Alabama, Diamond Rio, The Mavericks, Richoet and Sawyer Brown.

"Vocal Duo of the Year" -- Bellamy Brothers, Brooks & Dunn, Raybon Brothers, Thrasher Shiver and John & Audrey Wiggins; "Album of the Year" -- "Blue" (Rimes), "Carrying Your Love With Me" (Strait), "Did I Shave My Legs for This?" (Carter), "Everybody Knows" (Yearwood) and "Everything I Love" (Jackson).

"Musician of the Year" -- Eddie Bayers, Paul Franklin, Brent Mason, Matt Rollings and Brent Roway; "Single of the Year" -- "All the Good Ones are Gone" (Tillis), "Carried Away" (Strait), "It's Your Love" (McGraw and Hill), "One Night at a Time" (Strait) and "Strawberry Wine" (Carter).

"Vocal Event" -- the Charlie Daniels Band "Long Haired Country Boy," Clint Black and Martina McBride "Still Holding On," George Jones and Kathy Mattea "You've Got a Friend in Me," Lee Roy Parnell "John the Revelator: Peace in the Valley," and Graw and Hill "It's Your Love."

Songwriter's "Song of the Year" -- Dean Dillon and Bob McDill "All the Good Ones are Gone," Bill Mack "Blue," Bob Carlisle and Randy Thomas "Butterfly Kiss," Matrace Berg and Gary Harrison "Strawberry Wine" and Bobby Braddock "Time Marches On."
"Music Video of the Year" -- Mattea "455 Rocket," Tillis "All the Good Ones are Gone," Adkins "Every Light in the House," McGraw and Hill "It's Your Love," and Carter "Strawberry Wine."
